pattern: Verb Stem + ~거니와 (Not Only Is It True That... But Also)
meaningEn: Acknowledging a first fact while adding another related fact ('not to mention that... / as well as').
meaningId: Mengekspresikan pengakuan atas fakta pertama sekaligus menambahkan fakta lain yang sejalan ('belum lagi... / ditambah lagi').

notesEn.usage: Formal literary connector used to list two parallel facts, emphasizing that both hold true.
notesEn.nuance: Slightly more formal and stylistic than ~(으)ㄹ 뿐만 아니라.

notesId.formation: Kata Dasar Kata Kerja/Sifat + ~거니와. Kata Benda: Kata Benda + (이)거니와.
notesId.usage: Kata penghubung sastra/formal yang digunakan untuk mendaftarkan dua fakta sejajar, menekankan bahwa keduanya berlaku.
notesId.nuance: Sedikit lebih formal dan bergaya sastra dibandingkan ~(으)ㄹ 뿐만 아니라.

examples.hangul: 이 제품은 품질도 좋거니와 가격도 저렴합니다.
examples.romaja: i je-pum-eun pum-jil-do jo-geon-i-wa ga-gyeok-do jeo-ryeom-ham-ni-da.
examples.meaningEn: This product has good quality, as well as an affordable price.
examples.meaningId: Produk ini kualitasnya bagus, ditambah lagi harganya terjangkau.

examples.hangul: 그 사람은 경력도 많거니와 인성도 훌륭해요.
examples.romaja: geu sa-ram-eun gyeong-ryeok-do man-geon-i-wa in-seong-do hul-ryung-hae-yo.
examples.meaningEn: That person has extensive experience, not to mention a great character.
examples.meaningId: Orang itu pengalamannya banyak, belum lagi kepribadiannya sangat luar biasa.

examples.meaningEn: The weather is cold, as well as being very windy.
examples.meaningId: Cuacanya dingin, ditambah lagi anginnya bertiup kencang.

quiz.question: Which literary connector functions similarly to '~(으)ㄹ 뿐만 아니라' to add a parallel fact?
quiz.explanationEn: ~거니와 is a literary connector used to add an additional parallel fact.
quiz.explanationId: ~거니와 adalah kata penghubung sastra untuk menambahkan fakta sejajar lainnya.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: This product has good quality, as well as an affordable price. -> 이 제품은 품질도 좋___ 가격도 저렴합니다.
fillInTheBlank.sentenceHangul: 이 제품은 품질도 좋___ 가격도 저렴합니다.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Masukan kata penghubung penambah bergaya sastra.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'This product has good quality, as well as an affordable price.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Produk ini kualitasnya bagus, ditambah lagi harganya terjangkau.'
constructionQuiz.answer: 이 제품은 품질도 좋거니와 가격도 저렴합니다
constructionQuiz.answerReading: i je-pum-eun pum-jil-do jo-geon-i-wa ga-gyeok-do jeo-ryeom-ham-ni-da
acceptableVariants: 이 제품은 품질도 좋거니와 가격도 저렴해요
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use this product (이 제품은) + quality also good (품질도 좋) + as well as (거니와) + price also cheap (가격도 저렴합니다).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan produk ini (이 제품은) + kualitas juga bagus (품질도 좋) + ditambah lagi (거니와) + harga juga murah (가격도 저렴합니다).

pattern: Verb/Adj Stem + ~(으)ㄹ진대 (Given That / Since It Is Indeed)
meaningEn: Establishing a strong premise or universally accepted truth to justify the subsequent clause ('since / given that').
meaningId: Mengekspresikan premis kuat atau kebenaran umum untuk membenarkan klausa berikutnya ('mengingat bahwa / karena memang').

notesEn.usage: Archaic/high formal written connector used in solemn reasoning, speeches, or classic prose.
notesEn.nuance: Sets up a logical baseline: 'Since X is fundamentally true, Y must naturally follow.'

notesId.formation: Kata Dasar Kata Kerja/Sifat + ~(으)ㄹ진대. Kata Benda: Kata Benda + 인진대.
notesId.usage: Kata penghubung tertulis formal tinggi/kuno yang digunakan dalam penalaran khidmat, pidato, atau prosa klasik.
notesId.nuance: Menetapkan dasar logis: 'Mengingat X pada dasarnya benar, maka Y secara alami harus mengikuti.'

examples.hangul: 부모의 마음이 다 같을진대 어찌 자식을 걱정하지 않겠습니까?
examples.romaja: bu-mo-ui ma-eum-i da ga-teul-jin-dae eot-jji ja-sig-eul geok-jeong-ha-ji an-ges-seum-ni-kka?
examples.meaningEn: Given that all parents' hearts are the same, how could one not worry about their child?
examples.meaningId: Mengingat hati semua orang tua itu sama, bagaimana mungkin tidak mengkhawatirkan anak?

examples.hangul: 상황이 이럴진대 우리가 가만히 있을 수는 없다.
examples.romaja: sang-hwang-i i-reol-jin-dae u-ri-ga ga-man-hi is-seul su-neun eobs-da.
examples.meaningEn: Since the situation is indeed like this, we cannot just stand by.
examples.meaningId: Mengingat situasinya memang seperti ini, kita tidak bisa tinggal diam saja.

examples.hangul: 인간은 누구나 죽을진대 하루하루를 가치 있게 살아야 한다.
examples.romaja: in-gan-eun nu-gu-na ju-geul-jin-dae ha-ru-ha-ru-reul ga-chi it-ge sal-a-ya han-da.
examples.meaningEn: Given that all humans naturally die, one must live each day meaningfully.
examples.meaningId: Mengingat semua manusia pada akhirnya pasti mati, kita harus menjalani hari demi hari dengan berharga.

quiz.question: Which archaic formal connector sets a strong premise meaning 'given that / since it is true that'?
quiz.explanationEn: ~(으)ㄹ진대 sets a weighty premise or truth from which a conclusion is drawn.
quiz.explanationId: ~(으)ㄹ진대 menetapkan premis atau kebenaran berbobot dari mana suatu kesimpulan ditarik.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: Since the situation is indeed like this, we cannot stand by. -> 상황이 이럴___ 우리가 가만히 있을 수는 없다.
fillInTheBlank.sentenceHangul: 상황이 이럴___ 우리가 가만히 있을 수는 없다.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Masukan kata penghubung kuno yang berarti 'mengingat bahwa'.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'Since the situation is indeed like this, we cannot just stand by.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Mengingat situasinya memang seperti ini, kita tidak bisa tinggal diam saja.'
constructionQuiz.answer: 상황이 이럴진대 우리가 가만히 있을 수는 없다
constructionQuiz.answerReading: sang-hwang-i i-reol-jin-dae u-ri-ga ga-man-hi is-seul su-neun eobs-da
acceptableVariants: 상황이 이럴진대 우리가 가만히 있을 수는 없습니다
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use situation (상황이) + like this premise (이럴진대) + we (우리가) + quietly stay (가만히 있을) + cannot (수는 없다).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan situasi (상황이) + premis seperti ini (이럴진대) + kita (우리가) + tinggal diam (가만히 있을) + tidak bisa (수는 없다).

meaningEn: Expressing a near-miss scenario ('almost / nearly did X').
meaningId: Mengekspresikan skenario nyaris terjadi ('hampir saja / nyaris').

notesEn.usage: Always paired with ~(으)ㄹ 뻔했다 to describe a dangerous or regrettable event that was narrowly avoided.
notesEn.nuance: Emphasizes the close call or relief after a narrow escape.

notesId.formation: 하마터면 + Kata Dasar Kata Kerja + ~(으)ㄹ 뻔했다.
notesId.usage: Selalu dipasangkan dengan ~(으)ㄹ 뻔했다 untuk menggambarkan kejadian berbahaya atau disesali yang nyaris terjadi namun berhasil dihindari.
notesId.nuance: Menekankan situasi nyaris bahaya atau rasa lega setelah berhasil lolos tipis.

examples.meaningEn: The road was slippery, so I almost fell over.
examples.meaningId: Jalannya licin, jadi saya hampir saja terjatuh.

examples.meaningEn: I almost forgot an important appointment.
examples.meaningId: Saya hampir saja melupakan janji penting.

quiz.question: Which adverb is paired with '~(으)ㄹ 뻔했다' to emphasize a near miss?
quiz.explanationEn: 하마터면 specifically intensifies near-miss situations when combined with ~(으)ㄹ 뻔했다.
quiz.explanationId: 하마터면 secara khusus memperkuat situasi nyaris terjadi jika digabungkan dengan ~(으)ㄹ 뻔했다.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: I almost missed the bus. -> ___ 버스를 놓칠 뻔했어요.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Masukan kata keterangan yang menekankan 'hampir saja'.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'I almost missed the bus.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Saya hampir saja ketinggalan bus.'
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use almost (하마터면) + bus (버스를) + miss (놓칠) + almost happened (뻔했어요).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan hampir (하마터면) + bus (버스를) + ketinggalan (놓칠) + nyaris terjadi (뻔했어요).

pattern: Verb Stem + ~느니 차라리 (Rather Than X, I Would Rather Y)
meaningEn: Expressing a strong preference for Y over an unacceptable X ('rather than doing X, I would rather Y').
meaningId: Mengekspresikan preferensi kuat untuk Y dibandingkan X yang tidak dapat diterima ('daripada melakukan X, lebih baik Y').

notesEn.usage: Used when option X is so undesirable that option Y (even if extreme or inconvenient) is far preferred.
notesEn.nuance: Highlights extreme reluctance toward option X.

notesId.formation: Kata Dasar Kata Kerja 1 + ~느니 (차라리) Kata Dasar Kata Kerja 2.
notesId.usage: Digunakan ketika opsi X sangat tidak diinginkan sehingga opsi Y (meskipun ekstrem atau merepotkan) jauh lebih dipilih.
notesId.nuance: Menhighlight ketidakmauan yang sangat kuat terhadap opsi X.

examples.meaningEn: Rather than begging that person, I would rather starve.
examples.meaningId: Daripada mengemis pada orang itu, lebih baik saya kelaparan.

examples.hangul: 맛없는 음식을 먹느니 차라리 안 먹는 게 나아요.
examples.romaja: mas-eob-neun eum-sig-eul meong-neu-ni cha-ra-ri an meog-neun ge na-a-yo.
examples.meaningEn: Rather than eating tasteless food, I would rather not eat at all.
examples.meaningId: Daripada makan makanan yang tidak enak, lebih baik saya tidak makan sama sekali.

examples.hangul: 하루 종일 집에 있느니 차라리 산책이라도 나가겠어요.
examples.romaja: ha-ru jong-il jib-e it-neu-ni cha-ra-ri san-chaek-i-ra-do na-ga-ges-seo-yo.
examples.meaningEn: Rather than staying home all day, I would rather go out for a walk.
examples.meaningId: Daripada seharian di rumah, lebih baik saya pergi jalan-jalan.

quiz.question: Which expression means 'Rather than doing X, I would rather Y'?
quiz.explanationEn: ~느니 차라리 sets up a comparison rejecting X in favor of Y.
quiz.explanationId: ~느니 차라리 membuat perbandingan yang menolak X dan lebih memilih Y.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: Rather than begging that person, I would rather starve. -> 그 사람에게 구걸하___ 차라리 굶겠어요.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Masukan kata penghubung perbandingan yang berarti 'daripada'.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'Rather than begging that person, I would rather starve.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Daripada mengemis pada orang itu, lebih baik saya kelaparan.'
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use to that person (그 사람에게) + beg (구걸하) + rather than (느니) + would rather (차라리) + starve (굶겠어요).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan pada orang itu (그 사람에게) + mengemis (구걸하) + daripada (느니) + lebih baik (차라리) + kelaparan (굶겠어요).

pattern: Verb Stem + ~(으)ㄹ 락 말락 하다 (Flickering / On the Verge of X or Not X)
meaningEn: Describing an action or state that hesitates right on the threshold of happening ('on the verge of / barely about to').
meaningId: Menggambarkan tindakan atau kondisi yang berada tepat di ambang terjadi atau tidak ('nyaris / kumat-kamit / kempas-kempis').

notesEn.usage: Used when something repeatedly almost happens but doesn't quite fully materialize (e.g., falling asleep, rain starting, memory returning).
notesEn.nuance: Visual or sensory description of boundary state.

notesId.formation: Kata Dasar Kata Kerja + ~(으)ㄹ 락 말락 하다.
notesId.usage: Digunakan ketika sesuatu berulang kali hampir terjadi tetapi tidak sepenuhnya terwujud (contoh: hampir tertidur, hujan mau turun, ingatan samar-samar).
notesId.nuance: Deskripsi visual atau sensorik dari kondisi ambang batas.

examples.meaningEn: I am right on the verge of falling asleep.
examples.meaningId: Saya berada di ambang antara hampir tertidur dan belum.

examples.meaningEn: It looks as if it's about to rain any second.
examples.meaningId: Cuacanya seperti hampir mau turun hujan.

examples.hangul: 그 기억이 떠올라 올 락 말락 합니다.
examples.romaja: geu gi-eog-i tteo-ol-ra ol lak mal-lak ham-ni-da.
examples.meaningEn: That memory is on the tip of my mind.
examples.meaningId: Ingatan itu rasanya hampir teringat tapi belum muncul.

quiz.question: What scenario does '~(으)ㄹ 락 말락 하다' depict?
options: Something flickering on the exact edge of happening
A decision made firmly in advance
A command given to a subordinate
quiz.explanationEn: ~(으)ㄹ 락 말락 하다 describes an action hovering right on the threshold of occurring.
quiz.explanationId: ~(으)ㄹ 락 말락 하다 menggambarkan tindakan yang melayang tepat di ambang batas terjadi.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: It looks as if it's about to rain any second. -> 비가 올 락 ___ 하네요.
fillInTheBlank.hintEn: Insert second half of threshold pattern.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Masukan paruh kedua dari pola ambang batas.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'It looks as if it is about to rain any second.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Cuacanya seperti hampir mau turun hujan.'
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use rain (비가) + come or not threshold (올 락 말락) + looks like (하네요).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan hujan (비가) + ambang datang atau tidak (올 락 말락) + kelihatannya (하네요).
